## Schedule

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
w <- yaml::read_yaml("_variables.yml")$weeks
cat("| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Practical | Quiz |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
for (x in w) {
  if (is.null(x$folder)) {
    cat(sprintf("| %s | %s | *%s* | | | |\n", x$number, x$date, x$note %||% "No class"))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("| %s | %s | [%s](%s/index.qmd) | [Slides](%s/slides.qmd){target=\"_blank\"} | [Practical](%s/practical.qmd) | [Quiz](%s/quiz.qmd){target=\"_blank\"} |\n",
                x$number, x$date, x$topic, x$folder, x$folder, x$folder, x$folder))
  }
}
```
